review.headline: Long run 17.0 km completed at a steady, controlled 5:50/km, squarely inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band.
observations: All 17 km splits were exactly 5:50/km with avg HR 141-145 (mean ~143), a flat even effort that matches the 'steady and unhurried' intent.
Average HR 143 and max 146 sit in the easy zone, consistent with the 4-week easy HR average of 140.
Cadence held at 174 spm, matching recent runs, and efficiency of 1.20 is in line with the recent long run (1.22).
Distance and duration match the plan (17.02 km vs 17.0 km), with 113 m of elevation gain.
flags: Athlete note and RPE were not logged (RPE 0, no note), so subjective fatigue is unknown after this 17 km.
Week 2 completed 5 of 7 sessions and strength was not completed; CTL has drifted down (-6.8 over 7 days) while TSB is near neutral at +1.5.
